name: paddle-toolkit
description: Reusable workflows for building, testing, debugging, and operating Paddle Billing integrations.

interface.longDescription: Build, test, debug, and operate Paddle Billing integrations with reusable workflows for ChatGPT and Codex. Paddle Toolkit by SapienX guides repository-only implementation directly and connects to Paddle's live MCP through Paddle OAuth when a live account action is requested. Sandbox and live stay separate; credentials go directly to Paddle or the user's MCP client. Paddle Toolkit is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Paddle.
capabilities: Plan Paddle Billing architecture for an existing application
Design catalog, pricing, and localized pricing pages
Implement checkout and secure webhook processing
Synchronize subscriptions and gate application entitlements
Debug integrations and audit production readiness
Connect to Paddle live through Paddle's official MCP and OAuth
defaultPrompt: Add Paddle Billing to this app with a sandbox-first plan for checkout, webhooks, subscription sync, and entitlements.
Audit this Paddle Billing integration for launch risks and give me a prioritized fix list.
Create these products and prices in my Paddle sandbox using the connected Paddle MCP.
